title: Senior Digital Product Owner - Rental Data
description:
**career area:**


technology, digital and data**job description:**

**your work shapes the world at caterpillar inc.**

when you join caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. we are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. we don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

*cat digital is the digital and technology arm of caterpillar inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. with over 1\.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics and ai capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.***job summary:**


as a senior product owner for rental data and dealer integrations, you will play a critical role in shaping the foundation of caterpillar's digital rental ecosystem. you will own the vision, strategy, and evolution of the rental data model, ensuring rental information is consistently represented, understood, and leveraged across digital products, analytics, and customer experiences.


this role sits at the intersection of rental business operations, digital product management, data management, and dealer collaboration. you will work closely with rental subject matter experts, dealers, engineering teams, data analysts, and business stakeholders to define how rental data should be structured, connected, governed, and utilized across the enterprise.


a successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of rental business processes and concepts, enabling them to translate business needs into clear product requirements and provide domain expertise to engineering teams building and maintaining the underlying data capabilities. the ideal candidate is comfortable working with large datasets, analyzing data quality issues, writing sql queries, and using data\-driven insights to support product decisions.

**what you will do:**

* own and evolve the rental data model strategy to support current and future rental business needs across caterpillar and dealer networks.
* serve as the primary bridge between rental business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring business requirements are accurately translated into scalable digital solutions.
* define and prioritize the product roadmap and backlog for rental data and dealer integration capabilities.
* partner with rental business leaders and subject matter experts to establish common definitions, standards, and business rules for key rental entities such as equipment, customers, contracts, rates, invoices, jobsites, and fleet operations.
* drive alignment across teams on how rental data is captured, interpreted, and utilized throughout the digital ecosystem.
* lead dealer onboarding and integration initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of enterprise rental data standards and processes.
* identify business challenges, operational inefficiencies, and data gaps impacting customers, dealers, and internal teams, and define solutions that create measurable business value.
* analyze rental, customer, equipment, and dealer data to identify trends, business opportunities, data quality issues, and integration gaps.
* use data and analytics to validate business requirements, investigate production issues, support decision\-making, and measure business outcomes.
* partner with engineering teams to provide rental business context, clarify requirements, and support solution design and decision\-making.
* collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and architects to define data requirements, establish data standards, and ensure effective data governance practices.
* validate data accuracy and integrity by performing data analysis, data reconciliation, and root cause investigations across multiple systems and data sources.
* ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across dealer systems and enterprise platforms to enable trusted reporting, analytics, and customer\-facing experiences.
* collaborate with product teams, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to understand evolving needs and ensure the rental data model continues to support strategic business objectives.
* act as an advocate for the rental business throughout product development, ensuring business priorities remain at the center of technical implementation decisions.

**what you will have:**

* **business analysis:** knowledge of business analysis and the set of tasks, techniques and tools required to identify business needs; ability to recommend solutions that deliver value to stakeholders.
* **decision making and critical thinking:** knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
* **effective communications**: understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
* **software problem management:** knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for resolving software problems; ability to manage software problems in installed software products.
* **software product business knowledge:** knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; ability to manage install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.

**considerations for top candidates:**

* experience working in cross\-functional environments involving business stakeholders, engineering teams, data teams, and external partners.
* experience working with complex datasets and data models, including validation of data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* proficiency in sql and experience working with relational databases, data warehouses, or modern cloud\-based data platforms.
* experience using analytics and reporting tools such as power bi, tableau, databricks, snowflake, azure data explorer, or similar technologies.
* experience performing data validation, root cause analysis, data reconciliation, and cross\-system troubleshooting.
* familiarity with apis, system integrations, and data exchange concepts.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Backend (Platform)
description:
**who we are**
--------------



each of us at yoodli has faced our own communication challenges — overcoming a lisp, freezing during a job interview, feeling anxious about speaking up. that shared empathy shapes a culture that's uplifting, inclusive, and deeply authentic. we value **humility**, a **bias for action**, and the belief that we **win together**.



our team includes former employees from google, apple, microsoft, tableau, and beyond, united by a problem we've personally lived. we're headquartered in the heart of seattle, and we're having a lot of fun along the way. our culture is built on failing fast, iterating constantly, and taking bold bets.



we've raised **$60m** — including a $40m series b led by westbridge capital — backed by madrona, neotribe, cercano, and incubated at the allen institute for ai. we're valued at $300m and grew revenue 900% year\-over\-year.



our customers include google cloud, snowflake, databricks, ringcentral, sap, franklincovey, kornferry, sandler training, toastmasters, and many more — with learners in over 150 countries. results speak for themselves: google cloud certified 15,000\+ reps without scaling headcount. snowflake recovered 1,200\+ manager hours per quarter. harness cut training review time by 75%.



we've been featured in techcrunch, axios, the information, forbes, fast company, and more.



try the platform free at yoodli.ai.


**about this team**
-------------------



as part of the platform team, you'll be building the backend services and architecture that power our product. you'll have impact across the entirety of yoodli, across analytics, data, search, infrastructure, monitoring, cost management, security, and scaling. you'll work on our highest scale problems, go deep on technical challenges, and deliver solutions that allow us to scale quickly to match our customers needs. you'll do all this while getting to establish wide ownership and expertise.


**what we're hoping you bring**
-------------------------------


**mission alignment:** you believe in our vision and care deeply about helping people achieve more by communicating better


**backend expertise:** you have strong experience building scalable, reliable backend services that power great user experiences


**customer\-centric thinking:** you architect right\-sized solutions \- secure, maintainable, and built with the end user in mind


**craft and quality:** you hold yourself to a high bar for code quality and system design, and you make the engineers around you better


**about you**
-------------


* 5\+ years of professional development experience, shipping production code
* strong backend capabilities \- you've owned services end\-to\-end and have a track record of delivering in fast\-moving environments
* solid experience with cloud infrastructure (gcp, aws, or azure) and infrastructure as code
* proficiency in typescript or python, with the ability to debug complex distributed systems
* clear communicator who works well across engineering and product, and who gives and receives feedback well
* you understand how your work connects to business outcomes and user impact
* bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience
* ability to be on\-site in our seattle, wa 3 days a week(m, t, th)

**extra credit experience**
---------------------------


* nosql databases and kubernetes
* google cloud platform
* security and compliance experience

**what's in it for you?**
-------------------------


**huge impact opportunity:** define technical strategy and build foundational systems at a fast\-growing startup. work directly with the founding team and shape the future of ai\-powered communication coaching


**competitive compensation:** significant equity opportunities at a venture\-backed company


**base compensation:** $160k \- $190k


**join a fun, inclusive and highly motivated team culture (and help define it!)**

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Components)
description:
spacex was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. today spacex is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on mars.

**full stack software engineer (components)**  

  

the components engineering team develops the world's best flight hardware and fabricates it at an in\-house machine shop for starship. the team is making a next generation machine shop with advanced software and automation, an alien dreadnought machine that builds the machine. as a software engineer, you will design novel software solutions such as web applications for efficient factory operation, algorithms and ai to automatically create cnc programs, control and deployment of cnc machines, and much more. these improvements will enable rapid starship production rates of 100\+ per year as well as a quick development cycle, which are critical for spacex's moon and mars missions. previous manufacturing experience is not necessary, just the desire to make high\-quality software to rapidly build starships.


**responsibilities:**


* develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across many spacex teams
* own all aspects of software development, including design, testing, and deployment
* rapidly create new applications that improve the production cycle time in the machine shop and the time to go from cad to part in hand
* deep dive into your users' problems to find and create efficient solutions
* bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews


**basic qualifications:**


* bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, physics or other engineering discipline; or 2\+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree

* experience with unix\-like operating systems and tools like terraform, ansible, puppet for managing them

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
about the role:  

skechers it division is transforming our engineering practice by embracing high\-performing, cloud native apis and applications using a modern technology stack that includes serverless, microservices, containers, boomi ipaas, qa, and zero\-touch delivery pipelines. additionally, skechers is transforming our customer relationship management practices through adoption of the salesforce core crm and customer goods platform. the senior salesforce engineer is a key role within the software engineering and architecture organization and will be central to continually improving and enhancing the salesforce platform for skechers.
  

  

the senior salesforce engineer will collaborate and work within high\-velocity software engineering teams, bringing expertise in salesforce development, integrations, api gateways, and agile software delivery. the candidate should be an experienced and motivated technologist who possesses a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. should have excellent design skills, shows commitment, planning, integrity, and pragmatic approach to drive organization towards continual success.
what you'll do:

* lead and take ownership of all salesforce programmatic requests.
* develop soql code, apex classes and triggers and custom user interfaces leveraging lightning web components (lwc) and javascript.
* use salesforce apis using rest, soap, graphql and platform events
* experience in ipaas middleware platforms such as boomi, mulesoft and informatica.
* experience in sfdx, github for source code management and github actions for ci/cd pipelines
* experience in pmd ruleset and ensuring code quality
* experience in cloud platforms such as aws, erp systems such as oracle and the ability to integrate salesforce with cloud and erp systems
* responsible for architectural documentation and reviewing the development of solutions specified in technical design.
* support the salesforce administrator as necessary.
* take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
* work with the production support team to ensure fixes and enhancements are delivered in a timely fashion
* translate business process requirements into a detailed technical specification to meet business goals.
* ensure development activities are aligned with scope, schedule, priority, and business objectives.
* interface with both internal and external technical experts to implement solutions.


what you'll bring:

* strong salesforce sales cloud, service cloud, consumer goods cloud and marketing cloud product knowledge
* at least 5 years of salesforce apex development experience
* strong command of building and scaling rest apis
* strong command of integration concepts as they relate to retail business.
* strong command of enterprise architecture concepts.
* strong command of enterprise integration design patterns.
* extensive experience translating business requirements to an effective integration solution.
* excellent communication skills, work ethic, punctual, reliable with a desire to excel.
* must be organized, able to work independently and in a team environment.
* participate in all aspects of software development including design, implementation, and deployment, and monitoring.
* partner with other internal teams to deliver high quality solutions.
* experience with building and maintaining distributed micro services; debugging \& monitoring production environments.
* adhere to company standards and apply design principles and patterns to develop robust software.
* work with development methodologies, adhering to best practices.
* solve complex problems that combine existing solutions with new code where necessary.
* available for on\-call work during after\-hours and weekends.
* work in an agile environment with autonomy and efficiency.


requirements:

* b.s. in computer science or equivalent or proven years of experience.
* 10\+ years of software development experience.
* extensive experience implementing and developing in apex, lwc, and javascript
* familiarity with salesforce ai offerings such as einstein and agentforce
* web development experience with html, css, and javascript
* experience with aws lambda, api gateway, s3, and sqs a plus.
* experience working with ipaas middleware platforms such as boomi, mulesoft or informatica
* working knowledge of linux, windows, sql and nosql database systems, and networking.
* experience integrating with 3rd party apis.
* experience working with devops teams on implementing ci/cd pipelines and monitoring/alerting.
* ability to communicate complex topics with precision and accuracy.
* ability to categorize and communicate requirements accurately and effectively.
* experience working directly with business facing groups outside of development is a plus.
* experience working within an agile team a plus.


the pay range for this position is $125,000\-$160,000/yr usd.

**about skechers**


skechers, a global fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. serving over 180 countries and territories, skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 skechers retail locations.

title: Sr. Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
description:
**summary of responsibilities:**  

the senior data analyst, business intelligence \& data engineering is an elevated technical, analytical, and leadership role responsible for designing, developing, and delivering enterprise\-grade reporting, analytical datasets, semantic models, and data solutions that support internal stakeholders and external msp clients across the contingent workforce ecosystem. this role requires advanced technical ownership, data engineering capability, project delivery accountability, and team leadership.


the senior data analyst leads complex initiatives from requirements through production deployment, mentors and directs analysts, partners with business and technology leaders, and ensures reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, secure, performant, and actionable.


**description of essential duties and functions** ***(each duty and function listed indicates % of time to total 100%)*****:**


* enterprise reporting, visualization \& analytics leadership (30%)
  

	+ lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of power bi dashboards, paginated reports, analytical datasets, and executive scorecards for internal stakeholders and msp clients.
	+ translate complex business requirements into clear, performant, visually intuitive reporting solutions that surface trends, exceptions, insights, and recommended actions.
	+ establish and enforce reporting design standards, semantic model governance, version control practices, quality assurance routines, and performance tuning expectations.
	+ develop reporting solutions for contingent workforce program metrics, including spend, suppliers, requisitions, bill rates, compliance, tenure, diversity, utilization, sla performance, and program effectiveness.
	+ review and improve work produced by analysts to ensure accuracy, usability, stakeholder readiness, and alignment with agileone reporting standards.
* data modeling, transformation \& engineering (25% of time)  

	+ design and maintain advanced power bi semantic models using dimensional modeling, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, calculated tables, role\-playing dimensions, and reusable measures.
	+ develop complex dax measures, calculation groups, time intelligence logic, and business rules to support scalable workforce analytics.
	+ write, optimize, and troubleshoot sql queries, stored procedures, views, and data extracts across multiple source systems.
	+ build and support data ingestion, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, and refresh workflows using power query, sql, microsoft fabric pipelines, azure data services, or comparable cloud tools.
	+ apply medallion architecture concepts across bronze, silver, and gold analytical layers where appropriate, ensuring clean separation between raw, curated, and business\-ready data assets.
	+ validate data lineage, integrity, and reconciliation across vms platforms, enterprise systems, analytical layers, semantic models, and published reports.
* project management, delivery \& stakeholder leadership (20%)
  

	+ lead bi and data delivery projects from intake, discovery, requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, adoption, and post\-implementation support.
	+ develop project plans, define milestones, estimate effort, assign work, manage dependencies, identify risks, escalate issues, and communicate status to leadership and business stakeholders.
	+ facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirements sessions, design reviews, testing cycles, and production readiness reviews.
	+ balance competing priorities across client, operational, leadership, and internal team demands while maintaining quality, timeline discipline, and transparent communication.
	+ ensure deliverables meet agreed scope, acceptance criteria, data quality expectations, security requirements, and business outcomes.
* team leadership, coaching \& standards management (15%)
  

	+ provide day\-to\-day leadership, coaching, mentorship, and technical guidance to data analysts and other team members.
	+ lead peer reviews, solution design reviews, code reviews, data model reviews, and report quality checks.
	+ assign or coordinate work across team members, monitor progress, remove blockers, and support workload prioritization.
	+ build reusable templates, documentation, standards, and best practices that improve team consistency, scalability, and knowledge sharing.
* automation, governance \& continuous improvement (10%)
  

	+ leverage power automate, fabric pipelines, scheduling tools, scripting, or comparable automation capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
	+ document data sources, transformations, business logic, security assumptions, refresh processes, issue resolution steps, and support procedures.
	+ partner with data engineering, infrastructure, security, and governance teams to align reporting solutions with enterprise standards for access, privacy, performance, and maintainability.
	+ stay current with power bi, microsoft fabric, azure, aws, and analytics platform capabilities and recommend improvements that elevate agileone bi delivery.
	+ perform other job\-related duties as assigned.

**required qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data modeling, or related analytical roles.
* 3\+ years of advanced power bi experience, including power bi desktop, power bi service, semantic models, workspace management, performance tuning, and report governance.
* 3\+ years of advanced sql experience, including complex joins, aggregations, window functions, subqueries, stored procedures or views, performance optimization, and data validation.
* 2\+ years of practical data engineering experience involving data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, pipelines, cloud data platforms, data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, or curated analytical layers.
* strong experience with vms data structures and reporting concepts, including fieldglass, beeline, vndly, or comparable vendor management systems.
* demonstrated experience managing and delivering projects, including scope definition, planning, milestone management, stakeholder communication, risk mitigation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support.
* strong hands\-on experience with dax, including complex measures, calculation logic, time intelligence, reusable metrics, and performance optimization.
* strong hands\-on experience with power query (m), data cleansing, transformation design, and refresh troubleshooting.
* solid understanding of dimensional modeling, relational databases, star schemas, fact/dimension design, semantic modeling, and analytics engineering best practices.
* experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and reconciling discrepancies across systems, extracts, reporting layers, and dashboards.
* experience in contingent workforce, msp, staffing, workforce solutions, procurement, hr, or related operational data environments.
* knowledge of workforce metrics such as spend, bill rates, markups, requisitions, placements, tenure, compliance, diversity, supplier performance, sla performance, utilization, and program performance.
* ability to communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly to executive, operational, client, and technical audiences.

**preferred qualifications:**


* experience with microsoft fabric, including lakehouse, data warehouse, dataflows, pipelines, notebooks, semantic models, gateways, and refresh orchestration.
* working knowledge of azure data services such as azure data lake storage, azure sql, synapse analytics, data factory, key vault, entra id, networking, and security fundamentals.
* exposure to aws data environments, multi\-cloud analytics strategies, or cross\-platform data integration.
* experience applying power bi security models, row\-level security, object\-level security, workspace governance, data sensitivity labeling, and access control practices.
* experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts, or ai\-assisted analytics use cases.
* microsoft power bi data analyst associate, fabric analytics engineer, azure data engineer, pmp, agile, scrum, or similar certifications.

**supervision exercised/\# of staff:**


* functional leadership required. this role may directly or indirectly lead data analysts, contractors, offshore/onshore resources, or project team members depending on business need. responsibilities may include work assignment, coaching, conducting performance reviews, providing technical direction, performance input, and project delivery leadership. direct people management may be required based on organizational structure.

**skills requirements:**


* leadership and behavioral competencies
	+ leads through influence, clarity, accountability, and follow\-through.
	+ able to manage concurrent priorities, deadlines, stakeholder expectations, and operational demands in a fast\-paced environment.
	+ exercises independent judgment and discretion on matters of significance, including data interpretation, solution design, project priorities, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication.
	+ demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, professional presence, and the ability to build trust with clients, managers, peers, and team members.
	+ able to coach, delegate, inspect work quality, provide constructive feedback, and help team members grow technical and business capabilities.
	+ able to work independently, collaborate effectively, and make informed decisions under pressure.

**language/communication skills required** ***(written \& verbal)*****:**


* ability to read, analyze, and interpret business requirements, reporting specifications, technical documentation, data models, and analytical concepts.
* ability to present information with clarity to leaders, managers, clients, customers, technical teams, and general business audiences.

**computer/system skills requirements:**


* advanced power bi desktop and power bi service.
* advanced dax, power query (m), and sql.
* microsoft fabric, azure data services, cloud data platforms, data warehouse/lakehouse concepts, and automation tools.
* excel for analysis, reconciliation, validation, and stakeholder workbooks.
* vms systems such as fieldglass, beeline, vndly, or comparable platforms.
* collaboration and delivery tools such as teams, sharepoint, jira, azure devops, planner, smartsheet, or similar tools.

**certificates, licenses, registration requirements:**

* none required

**work environment/ physical or mental abilities:**
  

the demands described here are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

* available to work overtime when required to meet project, client, production support, or business\-critical deadlines.

title: Cloud Platform Architect
description:
the era of pervasive ai has arrived. in this era, organizations will use generative ai to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.



sambanova suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative ai platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. powered by the intelligent sn40l chip, the sambanova suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative ai into one of their most valuable assets.

### **about the role**



the cloud platform team is looking for a leader to take us from startup scrappy to enterprise grade, and define what platform engineering looks like at sambanova.


### **responsibilities**



in this role, you'll architecting our next\-generation system from the ground up, running the kubernetes infrastructure that powers some of the most advanced ai workloads in the industry, and bridging multi\-cloud and on\-prem environments in ways no generic saas company can offer. your work will directly impact the productivity of every engineer at sambanova and by extension, the speed at which we ship the future of ai computing.



some of your responsibilities include:


* architect, build, and maintain our next\-generation internal developer platform, automating and streamlining our cloud and on\-prem infrastructure
* design, write, and manage terraform modules to provision and manage resources across aws, gcp, and azure, ensuring consistency and reproducibility
* build and manage highly available, secure, and performant kubernetes clusters that serve as the primary runtime for our diverse ai workloads
* design and implement robust networking solutions (vpcs, load balancers, firewalls, service meshes) that seamlessly connect our multi\-cloud and hybrid environments
* collaborate with ai and software engineering teams to understand their needs, provide golden paths to production, and build internal tools that accelerate their development cycles
* implement best practices for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to ensure system reliability and performance, and participate in on\-call rotation

  


### **required qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience in devops, site reliability engineering (sre), or cloud infrastructure roles
* proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., python, go, rust)
* expertise with kubernetes (eks, gke, or self\-managed) in production environments \- pods, operators, crds, cnis, etc.
* expertise with infrastructure as code with the ability to manage complex, multi\-cloud environments
* strong proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (aws, gcp, or azure), with a solid understanding of the core services (compute, storage, networking, iam)
* networking fundamentals (tcp/ip, dns, http, load balancing) and security best practices in the cloud

### **preferred qualifications**


* experience in a hybrid environment bridging cloud and on\-premise/data center infrastructure
* experience managing infrastructure for data\-intensive or ml/ai workloads
* knowledge of building and maintaining ci/cd pipelines (e.g., gitlab ci, jenkins, argocd)
* experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., istio, linkerd)
* contributions to open\-source projects or a public portfolio of code (github)

**submission guidelines**  

please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at sambanova systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.


**eeo policy**  

sambanova systems is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.


**benefits summary for us\-based, full\-time employment positions**  

sambanova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. we cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a health savings account (hsa) with employer contribution. we also offer dental, vision, short/long term disability, basic life, voluntary life, and ad\&d insurance plans in addition to flexible spending account (fsa) options like health care, limited purpose, and dependent care. our library of well\-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to headspace, gympass\+ membership with access to physical gyms, one medical membership, counseling services with an employee assistance program, and much more.

title: Wi-Fi Infrastructure Test Engineer
description:
choosing capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**about the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


capgemini is seeking a highly skilled wi\-fi infrastructure test engineer to join our team and support the validation, testing, and optimization of enterprise wireless networking solutions. the ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with wi\-fi infrastructure testing, wireless network troubleshooting, and rack build\-outs of wi\-fi networking equipment. this role requires strong technical expertise in wi\-fi protocols, network performance analysis, and test automation using python.


the successful candidate will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining wireless test environments, executing functional and performance testing, identifying issues, and partnering with engineering teams to ensure the delivery of stable, high\-performing wi\-fi solutions.


**location**
------------


this is an onsite opportunity located in the greater philadelphia, pa metropolitan area.


**your role**
-------------


* design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for enterprise wi\-fi infrastructure solutions.
* build, configure, and maintain wireless networking test environments, including rack installation and integration of access points, controllers, switches, routers, and other networking equipment.
* perform functional, interoperability, scalability, performance, and reliability testing of wi\-fi infrastructure.
* validate wireless networking features across supported wi\-fi standards, including 802\.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax.
* analyze network traffic and packet captures using tools such as wireshark to identify, diagnose, and resolve network issues.
* troubleshoot wi\-fi connectivity, roaming, authentication, throughput, latency, and performance\-related issues.
* develop and enhance test automation tools and scripts using python to improve test efficiency and coverage.
* conduct real\-time traffic analysis, network monitoring, and performance optimization testing.
* validate wireless security protocols and authentication mechanisms, including wpa2, wpa3, eap, and related security standards.
* collaborate closely with software, firmware, hardware, and systems engineering teams to investigate defects and perform root cause analysis.
* document test results, defects, troubleshooting findings, and performance metrics.support continuous improvement initiatives for test methodologies, automation frameworks, and lab infrastructure.
**your skills \& experience**
-----------------------------


* bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in wi\-fi infrastructure testing, including rack build\-out and deployment of networking equipment.
* strong understanding of wi\-fi protocols and wireless networking principles, including 802\.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax
* strong python programming skills with experience developing network\-focused applications, automation tools, or test frameworks.
* experience performing wi\-fi testing, wireless infrastructure validation, and performance analysis.
* hands\-on experience troubleshooting wi\-fi networking issues and identifying root causes.
* strong working knowledge of network analysis tools such as wireshark for packet inspection, protocol analysis, and debugging.
* knowledge of wireless authentication and security protocols, including: wpa2, wpa3, eap, and 802\.1x authentication
* experience conducting real\-time traffic analysis and network performance optimization.
* familiarity with linux/unix operating systems and environments used for network tool deployment and testing.
* strong understanding of tcp/ip networking fundamentals.
* excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* strong attention to detail and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced engineering environment.

preferred qualifications


* experience with wi\-fi 6 and wi\-fi 6e technologies.
* knowledge of wireless controllers, enterprise access points, and cloud\-managed networking solutions.
* experience with automated test environments and ci/cd testing methodologies.
* familiarity with tools such as iperf, ixchariot, spirent, or similar network performance testing platforms.
* industry certifications such as cwna, cwnp, ccna, ccnp, or equivalent wireless/networking certifications.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
**description:**  

murphy\-hoffman company, llc is north america’s largest kenworth truck dealership group and leasing group. as mhc continues to grow, we have an opening for a full stack software engineer. the full stack software engineer is responsible for designing, building, and shipping customer\-facing and internal web applications. engineers work across the stack utilizing react ui, node.js services/apis, postgresql data modeling, and azure deployments. they partner with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver secure, scalable features. engineers are expected to leverage modern ai\-assisted development tools and emerging ai technologies where appropriate to improve productivity, code quality, user experiences, and business outcomes while adhering to established security, governance, and engineering standards. this position is fully in office 5 days a week in leawood, ks.
  
  

* develops and maintains full\-stack web applications using react and node.js, including user interface components, state management, and backend services and apis.
* designs, develops, and optimizes postgresql databases, including schemas, queries, migrations, and indexing strategies.
* deploys, operates, and supports applications and services on azure or other cloud platforms and implements ci/cd pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code as applicable.

**qualifications:**  

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related technical field.
* experience developing and supporting full\-stack web applications using react, node.js, postgresql, and azure.
* knowledge of http, api design, authentication and authorization methods, and application security practices.
* experience with git\-based development workflows, peer code reviews, automated testing, and end\-to\-end feature delivery.
* familiarity with ai\-assisted development tools and with responsible and secure use of generative ai technologies in software development.
* experience integrating ai\-enabled services or application features, as well as identity, access, and multi\-tenant application patterns in cloud environments.
* experience with typescript, modern javascript frameworks, containerization, orchestration, messaging/caching technologies, and observability tools.


**benefits:**  

* competitive salary
* medical, dental and prescription insurance
* disability and life insurance

* 401k and profit sharing with employer match
* flexible spending account
* internal promotion opportunities
* on the job training

title: Machine Learning Engineer, DesignX
description:
**what to expect**
as a machine learning engineer on the infrastructure designx team, you will play a critical role in developing and scaling the machine learning platform that optimizes and automates infrastructure planning and construction across our national buildout. you will focus on applying deep learning techniques to train neural networks on large\-scale datasets enriched with real\-world context from field engineers. training these models robustly at scale and shipping user\-friendly products on top of them in the shortest amount of time is central to our mission.


the machine learning platform empowers our engineers to design, build, and manage infrastructure across the nation faster and more efficiently. as infrastructure buildouts, power demands, and construction costs grow more than ever, we're looking for an exceptional machine learning engineer to drive scalability improvements and new capabilities across the platform.

 **what you'll do*** design, develop, train, and deploy machine learning solutions that leverage generative ai technologies, such as large language models (llms)
* develop computer vision models for object detection, segmentation, and classification to identify infrastructure components and site conditions
* build models that extract structured information from technical documents, drawings, and diagrams
* develop forecasting and predictive models that turn large\-scale operational data into reliable predictions
* combine multiple data sources, including image, audio, thermal, mechanical, weather, and other sensors, to develop and train end\-to\-end models
* analyze and improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of ai models through rigorous data\-driven experimentation, evaluation, and iterative training
* work closely with software engineers to productionize machine learning models and integrate them into scalable, reliable systems
* build and optimize model training, deployment, and monitoring workflows to enable high\-performance ai applications in production
  

**what you'll bring*** degree in computer science, or exceptional technical ability with practical machine learning experience
* proven experience in applying machine learning and ai techniques to solve real\-world problems, particularly with generative ai and llms
* strong proficiency writing production\-quality code with python\-based machine learning and deep learning frameworks (e.g., tensorflow, pytorch, jax, tgi/vllm, numpy)
* experience designing model architectures and/or building training workflows, evaluation tools, data pipelines, or inference optimizations
* experience developing computer vision models, such as object detection, segmentation, or classification, including extracting structured information from documents, drawings, or diagrams
* experience building forecasting or predictive models on large\-scale or time\-series data
* background in agentic systems and/or multimodal (vision \+ language) models
* experience with post\-training or rl methods (ppo, grpo, rlhf) is a strong plus
* ability to solve open\-ended and difficult technical problems with little guidance, with excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills
  

**compensation and benefits**

* medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits

* short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* employee assistance program
* sick and vacation time (flex time for salary positions, accrued hours for hourly positions), and paid holidays
* back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* weight loss and tobacco cessation programs

title: Software Engineer I
description:
**software engineer 1**

**we are lennar**


lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their homeowners, communities, and associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our associates throughout their career. lennar has been recognized as a fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the united states.


**join a company that empowers you to build your future**

we are seeking an early\-career back\-end/full\-stack software engineer to join our team building and evolving our flagship digital web presence. the ideal candidate has foundational experience (through internships, projects, coursework, or early professional work) with **.net** services, **sql** ( **sql server** a plus), and an interest in learning to design and operate **graphql** and **restful** apis. you will work alongside experienced engineers and cross\-functional partners to help deliver reliable, secure integrations across application services, data stores, and cms capabilities ( **optimizely** exposure is a nice\-to\-have). front\-end experience (e.g., **next.js** ) is a bonus but not required. above all, we're looking for someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute.


**your responsibilities on the team**

**software development:**

* develop and maintain back\-end and full\-stack services with guidance, ensuring scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* write clean, readable, and maintainable code, learning and applying best practices and coding standards.
* help build back\-end services using **.net** and contribute to api layers leveraging **graphql** (and rest as needed); learn to write and optimize data access patterns with **sql** (preferably **sql server** ). front\-end development in **react/next.js** is a plus.
* leverage ai tooling to supercharge productivity and accelerate your learning.

**architecture and design:**

* learn the architecture and design of software systems and how they align with business goals and technical strategy.
* participate in technical design reviews, asking questions and contributing ideas as you grow your understanding.

**testing and quality assurance:**

* develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to ensure software quality.
* help identify and resolve defects and performance issues, and participate in code reviews to learn and uphold high standards of code quality.
* work closely with qa teams to understand and apply testing strategies and processes.

**collaboration and teamwork:**

* collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high\-quality features and enhancements.
* participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to the continuous improvement of the team’s processes.
* communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, providing updates on progress and potential challenges.
* help troubleshoot and resolve incidents as needed.

**growth and development:**

* actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers, applying what you learn to improve your skills.
* demonstrate a strong work ethic, a commitment to quality, and a willingness to take on new challenges.
* take ownership of features or projects, driving them from concept to completion with appropriate guidance and support.

**continuous improvement and innovation:**

* stay curious about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team.
* identify opportunities for process improvements, refactoring, or technical enhancements to optimize the software development lifecycle.
* participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the team’s technical direction.

**requirements**

* **education** : bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **experience** : 0\-2 years in software engineering, with an interest in back\-end and full\-stack development across modern web platforms.
* **.net / api foundations** : some exposure to building scalable services using **.net** and an eagerness to learn api design with **graphql** and rest.
* **data \& cms integration** : familiarity with relational data modeling and **sql server** ; any experience with **sql server** or cms platforms ( **optimizely** a plus) is a bonus.
* **cloud exposure** : familiarity with deploying to or working with cloud services (e.g., **azure** , **aws** , or **gcp** ) is a plus.
* **agile mindset** : openness to working in agile environments and adapting quickly to evolving requirements and priorities.
* **problem solving** : solid analytical skills with a detail\-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to ownership and accountability.
* **communication** : excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* **initiative \& drive** : self\-starter with a passion for technology, continuous learning, and driving projects forward.
* **integrity \& quality** : committed to delivering high\-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions with professionalism and accountability.

**additional skills**


while this role is primarily back\-end/full\-stack focused, experience in these areas is a plus:


* **cms \& platform engineering** : any experience with or interest in cms platforms, with **optimizely** a nice\-to\-have (content delivery, personalization, workflows, and integrations).
* **cloud \& infrastructure** : basic familiarity with **cloud platforms** such as **azure** , **aws** , or **gcp** , and containerization tools like **docker** and **kubernetes** is a plus.
* **ci/cd \& devops** : any exposure to version control ( **git** ) and ci/cd tools like **azure devops** (ado) or **github actions** is a plus.
* **architecture \& databases** : an interest in learning api architecture ( **graphql** and rest), service design, and database design with **sql server** .
* **front\-end collaboration** : ability to collaborate effectively with front\-end engineers and, when needed, contribute to ui work in **react/next.js** is a plus.

**physical \& office/site presence requirements:**

**this is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. finger dexterity is necessary.**

at lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well\-being and professional growth. our associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. our 401(k) retirement plan, complete with a $1 for $1 company match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while paid parental leave and an associate assistance plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. to further support our associates, we provide an education assistance program and up to $30,000 in adoption assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. from the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous holiday, sick leave, and personal day policies. additionally, we offer a new hire referral bonus program, significant home purchase discounts, and unique opportunities such as the everyone’s included day. at lennar, we believe in investing in our associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. lennar associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. visit lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

title: Sales Engineer, DevOps
description:
**description**



keeper security is hiring an experienced sales engineer, devops to join our b2b sales team. this is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the chicago, il metro area.



keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for navigating our customers through the technical landscape of our products while serving as a devops subject matter expert.


**about keeper**



keeper security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any it environment. its core offering, keeperpam®, is an ai\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. recognized for its innovation in the gartner magic quadrant for privileged access management (pam), keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. learn why keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at keepersecurity.com.  

  

**the problem we solve for devops teams**

title: Platform Software Engineer II
description:
at braze, we have found our people. we're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.



we seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.



to flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. there is always a way to contribute: acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.



our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture.



if you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. if braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.


braze is the leading customer engagement platform, helping brands build personalized messaging experiences across push, email, in\-app, and more, at massive scale. we use a diverse technology stack rooted in ruby on rails, mongodb, redis, kafka, kubernetes, and more.



developer acceleration is a brand\-new team inside engineering. our job is to take braze's infrastructure primitives, like deployment, provisioning, and testing, and turn them into fast, self\-serve paths so engineers can build, test, and ship without stitching multiple systems together themselves. we also own the ramps our engineers use to build and deploy ai tooling internally, including the frameworks and guardrails that let braze build and run its own ai agents safely.



as a platform software engineer, you'll help build both sides of that mission from the ground up. this team is only a few weeks old, so you'll help shape how it works, not just what it ships.


**what you'll do**


* turn braze's infrastructure primitives, like deployment, provisioning, and testing, into simple, self\-serve paths so engineers can build, test, and ship without stitching multiple systems together themselves
* build the frameworks and guardrails that let engineering teams deploy internally\-built ai agents safely, including governance that controls what an agent can access and do
* partner with braze's engineering teams to define infrastructure\-as\-a\-service primitives, build monitoring and alerting that catches issues early, and help braze meet its enterprise\-grade slas
* provide the opinionated abstractions, tooling, and guardrails that let engineering teams use platform primitives safely, and keep improving the observability and everyday ergonomics of the tools they depend on
* this team doesn't run a formal on\-call rotation yet. as one stands up, you'll help shape it, backed by braze's dedicated platform support team who already absorb most day\-two firefighting


**who you are**


*this is a software and developer tooling role, not a systems administration role. if most of your experience is deep infrastructure work, heavy terraform ownership, or cluster administration, with less time spent building the software layer on top, this probably isn't the right next step for you.*


* 5\+ years of experience building developer tooling, ci/cd pipelines, or similar software. this is not an entry\-level or new\-grad role
* comfortable with kubernetes as something you build on top of and deploy to, not something you spend your day administering
* you care more about good service and software design than which language you're writing in. a growing share of code today gets written by ai tooling, so design judgment matters more than raw output
* you've built or explored developer platform integrations such as github apps, internal clis, or mcp (model context protocol), and you use ai tools in your own workflow with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
* you think about systems: interfaces, boundaries, edge cases, and failure modes
* you collaborate and document well across global, remote teams, and you'd rather fix something broken than walk past it


for candidates based in the united states, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $104,000 and $176,040/year with an expected on target earnings (ote) between $116,000 and $195,600/year (including bonus or commission). your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. in addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (rsus) so that you will own a piece of our company.



\#li\-hybrid


**what we offer**

  

*braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country* *here**. more details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*



from offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work\-life harmony. braze offers benefits such as:


* competitive compensation that may include equity
* retirement and employee stock purchase plans
* flexible paid time off
* comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
* family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
* professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
* a curated in\-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
* opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company\-wide volunteer week and donation matching
* employee resource groups that provide supportive communities within braze
* collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a great place to work®


**about braze**  

  

braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to be absolutely engaging™. braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. built on a foundation of composable intelligence, brazeai™ allows marketers to combine and activate ai agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the braze customer engagement platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. from cross\-channel messaging and journey orchestration to al\-powered decisioning and optimization, braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.



the company has been consistently recognized as a leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a g2 "best of marketing and digital advertising software product" in 2026\. braze was also named a 2026 best places to work by built in, a 2025 america's greenest companies by newsweek, and a 2025 fortune best workplace in technology™ by great place to work®. braze is also proudly certified as a great place to work® in the u.s., the uk, australia, and singapore.



the company is headquartered in new york with offices in austin, berlin, bucharest, chicago, dubai, jakarta, london, paris, san francisco, são paulo, singapore, seoul, sydney and tokyo.


**braze is an equal opportunity employer**

at braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.



building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. we're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. when applying and interviewing with braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you *you*.



we know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. if this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we'd love to meet you.  

  

**our ai\-powered braze recruitment process**  

  

at braze, we're committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. to help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use ai\-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.



this includes using ai to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision\-making. we also use ai for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

### **position description \& qualifications**

  

  

serco is seeking a data analytics and research analystto join our talented and fast\-paced advisory services, which supports federal programs assisting millions of people seeking government health insurance coverage. this dynamic position on the data analytics and research team will primarily work on the cms eligibility support (es) contract supporting the design and execution of research studies and complex analyses. the candidate will translate predictive, prescriptive, and strategic insights into program performance, consumer behavior, and potential fraud to help guide decision making and improvements.


the candidate ideally brings unique combination of subject matter expertise in conducting research and analyses using federal health and program data, and in collaboration with federal health smes (particularly as it relates to the health insurance marketplace, medicare, medicaid and chip) using analytical tools and methodologies to monitor program performance, detect compliance and fraud issues, and improve service delivery. the candidate demonstrates extensive program implementation capabilities, excel at project and contract management, and proficiency at conducting business development activities.


the successful candidate will have experience managing teams working on diverse cross\-cutting projects including program integrity and auditing research, under competing timeframes. the candidate will work with and have expertise breaking down complex concepts for many different stakeholders at different levels of technical understanding, such as serco leadership, service delivery, it, and operations, and cms executives and subject matter experts.


**in this role, you will:**


* serve as a subject matter expert for the research and data analytics team. this includes:
	+ stay abreast on es/marketplace processes and data and share with internal and client stakeholders
	+ present analyses and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, including senior leadership. utilize data storytelling techniques to break down complex concepts for audiences at different levels of technical understanding.
	+ design and conduct analyses to improve program performance, gain a deeper understanding of consumer behavior, and identify potentially fraudulent activities being conducted in the marketplace.
	+ propose and execute research studies and complex data analyses to identify challenges and barriers consumers encounter when seeking to obtain health insurance through the federal health insurance exchange.
	+ conduct literature reviews (including scoping reviews, narrative reviews, and systematic reviews) to develop evidence\-based recommendations and develop research questions for studies.
	+ working with internal and client stakeholders to develop and improve regular and ad hoc reporting, including through the use of power bi and tableau to enhance visual appeal of reports
	+ work with interdisciplinary teams to improve automation and innovation throughout the program, while ensuring data integrity and governance is at the forefront
* manage and/or coordinate research and data\-related projects that crosscut multiple teams and product lines.
* present research and data analysis findings and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, as well as represent serco and the cms es program at industry and academic conferences.
* collaboratively work with cms and serco teams, develop research reports, presentations, white papers, and manuscripts to be submitted for publication in peer\-reviewed journals.
* develop and maintain effective and efficient working relationships with the client, interfacing with government smes and serco teams.
* participate in business development activities, including relationship building, capture, and proposal writing.
* perform other tasks as required or assigned.

**to be successful in this role, you will have:**


* a bachelor’s degree in public health, data science, statistics, or related field required.
* a minimum of 5 years of experience conducting public health research studies and/or complex quantitative analyses using sql, python, r or other related software.
* the ability to develop, model, and use data from various sources (program data, public data sources) for data analysis.
* experience creating and maintaining dashboards using data visualization tools such as powerbi and tableau.
* proficiency in programming languages such as python and sql; experience with r or similar languages is a plus.
* strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights and data findings clearly and effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* experience managing complex, research and/or data\-related projects that cross\-cut multiple teams and product lines from inception to completion
* the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including it, data engineers, policy smes, audit smes, and product line teams to enhance accessibility and availability of data and reporting across the program.
* demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining data governance frameworks, metadata management systems, and data catalog tools

**additional desired experience and skills:**


* graduate degree in public health, statistics, or other related field preferred
* understanding of aca and marketplace data and policy issues affecting consumer coverage
* experience working with midas database, including running queries, conducting analyses, and creating reports using midas data.
* experience working with federal government agencies, especially cms, to support data collection, management, analysis, and reporting efforts.
* practical experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., amazon redshift, databricks) and artificial intelligence and machine learning tools (e.g., amazon sagemaker and quicksuite)

title: Data Scientist I, Tech
description:
**about the role and team**  

  

science at uber means transforming the complex reality of global data into the insights that power our most significant decisions. as a data scientist i, you will turn complexity into clarity by deep\-diving into massive, multi\-dimensional datasets to support the evolution of our core platforms and marketplaces. this is an analytics\-focused role where you will learn to navigate ambiguous data environments, verifying the functionality of our systems and identifying opportunities to improve the user journey for millions of riders, earners, and merchants.  

  

you will join a high\-stakes environment where the work is fast\-moving, and the results are felt in the real world every day. collaborating closely with senior scientists and product partners, you will build foundational insights and monitor product quality in production to ensure our decisions are rooted in rigor. this role is about growth and operational impact \- if you want to solve the messy reality of global business challenges through data while learning from the best in the industry, this is where you'll grow.  

  

**rate of pay:** $125,000 to $139,000 per year  

  

you will be eligible to participate in uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. you will also be eligible for various benefits. more details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.
  

  

**what you'll do*** leverage data to perform intensive analysis across all areas of business to drive product development.
* design experiments and analyze results to draw conclusions.
* perform time\-series analyses, hypothesis testing, and causal analyses to statistically assess relative impact and extract trends.
* build models to enhance understanding of user behavior and predict future performance of cohorts.
* create dashboards and reports to regularly communicate results and monitor key metrics.
* extract data from warehouse, back\-test the model, and compare the model performance and communicate the results.
* develop end\-to\-end solutions to abstract business and engineering problems related to funnel optimization, user engagement, and user experience.
* may telecommute.

**basic qualifications*** employer will accept a bachelor's degree in engineering (any), information technology, information management, information systems, data science, mathematics, statistics, or related field.
* position requires:
	+ r or python;
	+ database query languages: sql;
	+ experimentation techniques including simulation or a/b testing;
	+ statistical analysis including descriptive statistics, correlation, regression, or confidence intervals;
	+ developing relevant metrics;
	+ kpis to measure performance by product teams;
	+ quantitative modeling including machine learning models, time\-series forecasting, or casual impact analyses;
	+ data visualization tools such as tableau, google sheets, excel, and charting libraries.

  

**ready to ride?**  

  

this isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. if you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

you may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. explore our benefits.
  

  

offices remain key to collaboration and uber's culture. unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. ask your recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

uber is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. we also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. if you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

about the role:


suzano is looking for a **data scientist** to help drive data\-informed decision\-making across our business operations. this role will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing predictive models, identifying trends, and delivering actionable insights that support operational excellence, sustainability initiatives, and strategic growth. the ideal candidate will combine strong analytical expertise with business acumen and a passion for solving complex problems through data. we are searching for someone passionate about data science and advanced analytics, with aspirations to grow with suzano's international footprint.


what you’re going to do:


* analyze large, structured, and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business improvement.
* develop, test, and deploy predictive and prescriptive analytics models to support operational and strategic objectives .
* collaborate with business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into data\-driven solutions.
* design and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that communicate insights effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* perform data mining, statistical analysis, and machine learning modeling to improve business performance and decision\-making.
* partner with it, operations, finance, supply chain, and other business functions to drive analytics projects.
* ensure data quality, integrity, and governance standards are maintained across analytics initiatives.
* develop data pipelines and automate processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
* monitor and evaluate model performance, making adjustments as needed to optimize outcomes.
* stay current on emerging technologies, methodologies, and best practices in data science and analytics.
what we expect from you:


* bachelor's degree in data science , statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, analytics, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* 3\+ years of experience in a data scientist, data analyst, business intelligence, or related analytics role.
* strong proficiency in python, r, sql, or other data analysis and programming languages.
* experience with statistical modeling, machine learning techniques, and predictive analytics.
* strong knowledge of data visualization tools such as power bi, tableau, or similar platforms.
* experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
* ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
preferred qualifications:


* master's degree in data science , analytics, statistics, computer science, or a related field .
* experience with cloud platforms such as azure, aws, or google cloud.
* knowledge of manufacturing, industrial operations, supply chain, or sustainability analytics.
* experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
* familiarity with data engineering concepts, etl processes, and data warehousing.
* experience with ai, generative ai, or advanced analytics solutions.
* strong critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze problems, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
